answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.037, below every category's range (fine-tuned 0.086-0.092, system-prompted 0.113-0.133), and the layer-2 spike is 0.1. That tiny spike rules out system-prompted (31.7-64.0). It also sits oddly for quantized, which has a layer-1 difference of about 0.10. The difference grows steadily to 0.565 at layer 32, higher than the quantized range of 0.247-0.255, and onset is at layer 2, which fits fine-tuned drift. KL of 0.490 and top-1 agreement of 0.879 are beyond the quantized range. Refusals added (9), disclaimers up to 23% and very short replies up to 30% show a behavior shift, which fits fine-tuning, and a mean length drop to 50.8 is also consistent. Median first divergence of 1 and edit distance of 0.772 are closer to system-prompted, but the activation profile does not match, and the fine-tuned effective rank of 2.89-3.58 is not matched exactly (3.92 measured). The values are out of range for every category, so this is the best fit rather than a clean match. Fine-tuned (stronger fine-tune) is the best explanation.
